thread:
jane_acme: Hey team — our GCP Marketplace invoice GCP-ACME-2026-03-02 has a mysterious $1,200 "Marketplace forwarder" line. Our Redwood dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens, but the GCP line item math looks like ~2.1M tokens. We didn't see any surge. Can someone help reconcile? I attached the invoice PDF in case it helps.

mike_support: Thanks for flagging — can you paste the exact line item SKU/text and the invoice line id from the PDF? Also are you on hosted Redwood API or Dedicated?

jane_acme: Invoice line id is line-789012. SKU text: "GCP Marketplace - Partner Forwarder (SKU12345)". We're on hosted API (api.redwood.ai) with tenant acme-prod.

emily_billing: putting on billing's queue. Two quick asks: 1) can you export the GCP billing export for March and share the raw CSV/parquet link, 2) any chance you used a partner reseller or purchased through a third-party? :thinking:

jane_acme: No reseller AFAIK — bought directly through our org. I'll get the export link in a minute.

raj_cloud: From experience this smells like the GCP marketplace "forwarded_tenant_id" issue where usage sometimes gets attributed to a partner account when partner SKUs or mapping attributes are present. If GCP attributes forwarded_user or partner_id you can see doubled counts between invoice and our internal meter mapping.

raj_cloud: Quick repro query (BigQuery against GCP billing export):
```
SELECT
  usage_start_time,
  invoice_id,
  invoice_billing_account_id,
  sku_id,
  sku_description,
  usage_amount,
  CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(resource.labels, '$.forwarded_tenant_id') AS STRING) AS forwarded_tenant
FROM `gcp_billing_export.acme_dataset.gcp_billing_export` 
WHERE invoice_id = 'GCP-ACME-2026-03-02' AND sku_id LIKE '%SKU12345%'
ORDER BY usage_start_time
LIMIT 50;
```

raj_cloud: If forwarded_tenant is non-null for many rows, that explains why the invoice shows partner-forwarded volume separate from the usage we ingest.

kevin_sre: I scanned our internal billing mapping and found a few recent marketplace SKUs that don't have a mapping to tenant_id, so fallback logic currently attributes them to `partner_account` for safety. That's likely the root cause. Small snippet from our sync log: 
```
2026-03-02T09:12:02Z WARN  billing-sync] missing sku_map entry for SKU12345 -> attributed to partner_account
2026-03-02T09:12:02Z INFO  billing-sync] raw_usage=2100000 tokens, mapped_to=partner_account
```

billing-bot: Automated check complete — found orphaned invoice lines: ["line-789012"] with SKU "SKU12345" that do not map to any active tenant mapping. Suggested action: request raw GCP invoice CSV and open GCP support case.

emily_billing: Plan proposal: 1) ask GCP for the detailed marketplace usage CSV and the marketplace partner forwarding log, 2) run Raj's BigQuery query to confirm forwarded_tenant presence, 3) cross-check against our raw ingestion logs (I can pull by invoice_id), 4) if double-attribution confirmed, request credit from GCP and issue a customer-facing adjustment/credit.

mike_support: I'll coordinate with the customer on steps 1 and 3. Jane — can you grant us read access to the billing export bucket or share a signed gs:// link? Example command GCP side: 
```
gsutil cp gs://billing-exports/acme/2026/03/part-000*.parquet /tmp/
# or BigQuery export
bq --project_id=acme-project query --nouse_legacy_sql 'SELECT ...' > march.csv
```

jane_acme: Sharing a signed URL now: https://storage.googleapis.com/billing-exports/acme/2026-03/march.parquet?XXXXXX (expires in 24h).

raj_cloud: Got it — I'll run the query against that export and post a few example rows.

raj_cloud: Example rows showing forwarded_tenant: 
```
usage_start_time: 2026-03-15T01:00:00Z, sku_id: SKU12345, usage_amount: 450000, forwarded_tenant: partner-987
usage_start_time: 2026-03-20T13:00:00Z, sku_id: SKU12345, usage_amount: 200000, forwarded_tenant: null
```

raj_cloud: See how some rows have forwarded_tenant populated and others don't — GCP can surface partner-forwarded usage separate from direct-usage. Our ingestion currently sums both unless our SKU mapping pins to tenant_project_id.

kevin_sre: Short-term fix: update billing-sync to prefer `resource.labels.project_id` (customer project) over forwarded_tenant when project_id is present. I'll open a PR with guardrail and mention this incident in the changelog. That prevents future double-claims. :white_check_mark:

emily_billing: Operational steps for billing: open GCP support case referencing invoice GCP-ACME-2026-03-02 and line-789012, include the exported CSV and our mapping evidence showing the same usage. Request adjustment/credit for partner-forwarded portion. I'll draft the support case now.

mike_support: Jane — can you confirm you're ok with us sharing the invoice and the raw billing export with GCP support (we'll include redaction policy and only share what's necessary)?

jane_acme: Confirmed, go ahead. Please cc me on the support thread.

emily_billing: Filed support case #GCP-987654, included CSV and example rows. GCP acknowledged and asked for a few more raw logs from the partner forwarder — they expect 24-48h for a response.

billing-bot: Update: support case GCP-987654 status=acknowledged, expected_next_update=2026-03-18 18:00 UTC.

raj_cloud: Follow-up internal action items: (1) Kevin to push PR to prefer project_id mapping, (2) Emily to keep billing case open and share when GCP confirms adjustment, (3) Mike to monitor the customer's invoice and confirm any applied credits.

kevin_sre: PR opened -> https://git.redwood/infra/billing-sync/pulls/412 (adds project_id-first logic, unit test, roll out to canary).

jane_acme: Thanks team — appreciate the quick triage. Please keep me posted on credits, and happy to help with any follow-up. :pray:

mike_support: Will do. Leaving this thread open until GCP confirms adjustment.

emily_billing: Marking root cause : probable (GCP forwarded_tenant + missing SKU mapping). Next update once GCP responds. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
